stemMd: Which process separates components mainly by differences in boiling point?
explanationMd: Distillation vaporizes more volatile components preferentially and then condenses the vapour. Differences in boiling behaviour therefore drive separation. The other methods rely on size, magnetism or settling rather than volatility.

distractorRationale.e: Filtration mainly separates particles from a fluid by size and insolubility.
distractorRationale.d: This separates solid particles by size.
distractorRationale.b: This relies on settling and phase separation, not boiling-point differences.
